items.title: OpenAI partners with Scale to provide support for enterprises fine-tuning models
items.summary: OpenAI’s customers can leverage Scale’s AI expertise to customize our most advanced models.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与Scale AI达成合作，为需要定制和微调OpenAI最先进大模型的企业客户提供专业的AI技术支持与定制服务。原始信息显示：OpenAI’s customers can leverage Scale’s AI expertise to customize our most advanced models.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI partners with Scale to provide support for enterprises fine-tuning models”。其重要性主要体现在：该合作有助于推动企业级大模型微调和实际落地应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
